newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures close $3 down, tracking crude.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures close $3 down, tracking crude.

text.p: IPE February gas oil futures last traded down $3 on Friday after recovering in sympathy with crude from a NYMEX-inspired slump, traders said.
February IPE gas oil finished at $215.75 a tonne, after toucing $214.75 in mid-afternoon. It was helped higher by NYMEX crude which firmed on short covering.
The mid-afternoon slide was triggered by stop loss selling followed by sharp early losses on NYMEX products.
"Gas oil followed crude higher, helped by the widening Feb/spread March on WTI," a trader said, adding activity in the gas oil contract was thin and mainly local.
March Brent crude was trading down 13 cents at $22.94 a barrel at 1801 GMT after hitting $22.64 in the mid-afternoon slump.
The front month contract has lost $1.97, trading down to a low of $22.56, since the high last week of $24.91, which itself was close to the six-year peak of $25.06 from October.
